fusions.name: Throat Grip
fusions.desc: Grabs one enemy within 2 tiles by the throat, dealing 9 damage, stunning it for 1 second and silencing it for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Wring the Neck
fusions.desc: A twisting grip that deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to it. Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health.

fusions.name: Unshaking Aim
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to steady yourself, then increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Grip
fusions.desc: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 10% more damage.
